scope: Commit rule refuses a newly added reader document that wiki/index.md does not reach within two links

fact_evidence.machine_consumed_planning_handoff: No handoff record is consumed by a machine.
fact_evidence.shared_contract_mutation: The commit rule is a shared control applied in every repository.
fact_evidence.consequential_external_mutation: Nothing is published or sent outward.
fact_evidence.continuity_beyond_session: Finished and merged in this session.
fact_evidence.one_writer: One session (code-83) edits the commit rule code.
